descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The North Atlantic, 14 April 1912. From a lifeboat on a flat, starlit sea you watch the greatest ship in the world sail past, every porthole lit. Then the present day: you are in the pilot seat of a modern explorer submarine, and the dive begins.

A NARRATED DESCENT
Sink from sunlit water into the midnight zone while the narrator tells the story of the ship. Dolphins, turtles, manta rays, sharks and whales pass the dome on the way down, then the glowing life of the deep.

THE WRECK AT TRUE SCALE
The bow rises out of the dark exactly as large as it is. Fly your submarine along the bow section, across the debris field and around the stern, each built to the real dimensions of the ship.

AN 18-STOP GUIDED TOUR
Follow the tour from the bow rail to the propellers: the anchors, the foremast, the bridge, the captain's bath, the Marconi room, the grand staircase, the boilers, the engines and more. Every stop is narrated. Fly it yourself or let the autopilot take you.

THE TIME LENS
Press one button and the ship as she was built is drawn in light over what remains.

LIGHT THE DEEP
Sweep the wreck with your floodlights, ping the sonar, and drop your own lights to hold a deck out of the darkness.

WALK YOUR SUBMARINE
Stand up from the pilot seat and walk the bridge and the salon of your boat while it holds station over the wreck.

A calm, respectful experience: nothing can hurt you and there is no timer. Play seated or standing. No account, no internet, no in-app purchases.
